documented_finding: P6 describes the daily trip total as the household expansion factor multiplied by trips reported by each household and summed over households.

The local relational tables contain fexp_hg and fexp_vj. Both are complete, numeric, positive, and constant within household, but differ for 90,194 of 100,174 trip records. Repeated sums are 16,723,042.90 and 16,723,043.30 respectively.
